name: Nimble Climber
source: Advanced Race Guide pg. 1, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1
body:
Nimble Climber (Ex)
Source Advanced Race Guide pg. 1, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1
(Catfolk Only) A catfolk rogue with this talent gains a +4 bonus on Climb checks. If she has the climber racial trait, she can take 10 on her Climb checks even when in immediate danger or distracted.
